newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA and Med fuel oil bunkers lose $1-$2.
newsitem.headline: ARA and Med fuel oil bunkers lose $1-$2.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers dipped by around $1/$2 a tonne on Thursday, and Mediterranean prices came off by a similar amount, dealers said.

Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $85/$87 fob, thus losing the $1/$2 they gained on Wednesday. The losses resulted from three to four players trying to shift product in the barge market. Some traders said they were set to flood the market with material this month.
Bunker suppliers said the effect of the price fall, as usual, was to discourage buyers who hope for further weakness.
"We had a few enquiries this morning, but now it's really very low," one supplier said.
Hamburg bunkers also rose by $1/$2 to around $91/$92 fob. German demand was also thin.
Mediterranean bunkers were about $1 a tonne lower. Benchmark quotes subsided after a period of strength induced by a number of trading houses as they priced cargoes into, for example, Romania.
Egyptian prices followed the Mediterranean pattern. Supplies in Port Said remained tight.
